stem.text: A lorry travels at a constant speed and then decelerates until it stops.
Which graph shows the variation with time of the distance travelled by the lorry?

A.alt: Distance against time: curve starts at the origin with increasing gradient, then becomes a horizontal line

B.alt: Distance against time: curve starts at the origin with decreasing gradient, then becomes a horizontal line

C.alt: Distance against time: horizontal line at a positive distance, then curve falling to zero distance

D.alt: Distance against time: curve starts at a positive distance and falls with decreasing gradient to zero distance
